title: 8.5. Hetuhetusampayuttaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetuvippayutto ceva na nahetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca nahetuvippayutto ceva na nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.

Nahetuvippayuttañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetuvippayutto ceva na nahetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuvippayuttañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuvippayuttañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca nahetuvippayutto ceva na nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
Nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca nahetuvippayuttañceva na nahetuñca dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
